title: UTA TRAX Stops
description: UTA TRAX Stops in Sandy City, Utah. The upstream service publishes no description for this layer. 111 point features, mirrored as GeoParquet in EPSG:3566 (NAD83(HARN) / Utah Central (ftUS)) with Web Mercator vector tiles for display. See the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) for the schema, the coded-value lists and queries that run.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: Esri object identifier. A row number assigned by the source geodatabase and reassigned when the layer is republished. It is not a stable key and must not be used to join across collections or across refreshes.

table:columns.name: stopabbr_j
table:columns.description: Abbreviated stop name used by the transit operator. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 111 rows, 111 distinct values.

table:columns.name: uta_stopid
table:columns.description: Utah Transit Authority stop identifier. UTA is the regional transit operator; this is their key, not Sandy's. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 111 rows, 111 distinct values, ranging 101394 to 198711.

table:columns.name: avgboard
table:columns.description: Average daily boardings recorded at the stop. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 111 rows, 57 distinct values, ranging 68 to 1220.

table:columns.name: avgalight
table:columns.description: Average daily alightings, meaning passengers getting off, recorded at the stop. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 111 rows, 57 distinct values, ranging 62 to 1264.

table:columns.name: route
table:columns.description: Routes Served. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 111 rows, 6 distinct values.

table:columns.name: mode
table:columns.description: Transit mode served at this stop. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 111 rows, 1 distinct values.

table:columns.name: county
table:columns.description: County the feature falls in. Sandy is in Salt Lake County. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 111 rows, 1 distinct values.

table:columns.name: city
table:columns.description: City the feature falls in. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 111 rows, 9 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Shape
table:columns.description: Residual Esri geometry field. It carries no coordinates here; the geometry is in the `geometry` column.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, WKB encoded, in the collection's `proj:epsg` coordinate system.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box written by gpio, as a struct of `xmin`, `ymin`, `xmax`, `ymax`, in the same coordinate system as the geometry. Rows are in Hilbert order, so filtering on this column prunes row groups efficiently.
